kind: gen_input (benchmark four-column per-state material table; accepted Monte Carlo consumer uses C, v_x, tau only; graded on aggregate invariants)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L7/data/full_modes_{Si,Ge}.h5, the arrays behind the accepted Monte Carlo input tables L7/data/modes_{Si,Ge}.txt (commit af1723c, reviewer human audit 2026-09-07), velocities rotated into the cubic frame by L2/auditor/guards/frame.json; the record's closure against the L2 RTA conductivity is 1.7e-6 (Si) and 3.7e-7 (Ge), L7/auditor/mode_export_{Si,Ge}.json. Re-derived from the staged files by reviewer/make_reference_submission.py (reference_vs_record.json).
table_format: four whitespace-separated columns per row, no header: nu [THz], C [J/m^3/K], v_x [m/s], tau [s]

n_rows.rule: exact integer (rule 2(4)); 6 x 25^3 states minus the three without a scattering rate

sum_C_J_m3_K.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); total volumetric heat capacity at 300 K

kappa_xx_W_mK.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); sum C v_x^2 tau over the rows

kappa_below_3THz_W_mK.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); the same sum over rows with nu < 3 THz

fourth_moment_W_m_K_s2.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); sum C v_x^4 tau over the rows, the |v_x| distribution of the conductivity: the deterministic variants tested during authoring agree within 5 percent (axis [111] within 4 percent), the isotropic-speed shortcut v_x = +-|v|/sqrt(3) misses by 45 percent

odd_ratio.rule: |sum C v_x tau| / sum C |v_x| tau <= 0.0001 (absolute band, zero target, rule 2(2))

n_rows.rule: exact integer (rule 2(4)); 6 x 25^3 states minus the three without a scattering rate

sum_C_J_m3_K.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); total volumetric heat capacity at 300 K

kappa_xx_W_mK.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); sum C v_x^2 tau over the rows

kappa_below_3THz_W_mK.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); the same sum over rows with nu < 3 THz

fourth_moment_W_m_K_s2.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); sum C v_x^4 tau over the rows, the |v_x| distribution of the conductivity: the deterministic variants tested during authoring agree within 5 percent (axis [111] within 4 percent), the isotropic-speed shortcut v_x = +-|v|/sqrt(3) misses by 45 percent

odd_ratio.rule: |sum C v_x tau| / sum C |v_x| tau <= 0.0001 (absolute band, zero target, rule 2(2))

not_graded.transport_axis: the cubic [100] axis is the physical specification; for a cubic crystal every graded aggregate is direction-independent to well inside the tolerance (sum C |v_x| changes by 3.7 percent between [100] and [111]), so the axis choice is not resolved by the grader (notes.md)
not_graded.per_state_values: graded only through the aggregates above; passing does not certify each row or column independently. Compensated wrong tables and local near-degenerate velocity differences are documented in notes.md; human decision retains this rubric without a per-state matcher.
not_graded.extra_runs: labels beyond Si and Ge are ignored

score: 1 only if every primary check of both materials passes (binary all-primary-pass)
